description: Per-character domain-expansion configuration: timing, target selection, stage/binding behavior, buffs, forced actions and rate-profile references.

Id.simple: Domain-expansion row key for a character.
Id.technical: FName row key; export label ID. AGameCharacter resolves an optional row from DomainExpansionDataTables using CharacterSpecialAttackRow->Id_DomainExpansion and caches it at AGameCharacter::DomainExpansionRow (+0x418); it may be null. Battle preload and pre-battle code perform the same lookup by that ID. Most gameplay consumers access the cached pointer rather than resolving the row again.

Id_Map.simple: Map row used as the domain's battle stage.
Id_Map.technical: FName key into MapDataTable. FBattleFreeState_DomainExpansion::GetStageMapRow uses this ID while the domain is active (after finish it uses the pending battle-level request instead) and sets bHasDomainMap from !IsNone(). The domain Sub2 state requests that stage on Enter except for CP130, and GameTrapManager also resolves it via Status_FindMapRow. None means no domain map/substates.

CastingTime.simple: Base seconds required to cast the domain expansion.
CastingTime.technical: float seconds. GetDomainExpansionCastingTime and ResetDomainExpansionCastingTime use FMath::Max(sum of EGameEquipmentItemEffectType::DomainExpansionCastingTime over equipped item IDs + this base, 0.0f); the casting ratio divides DomainExpansionCastingTimeLeft by that clamped total. Non-positive totals yield a zero ratio. Action controllers use the same getter to drive casting animation/progress.

Duration.technical: float seconds. StartDomainExpansionTime(true) copies it into DomainExpansionTimeLeft; IsDomainExpansionTimeOver only reports true when Duration > 0 and the remaining time reaches 0; GetDomainExpansionDurationRatio divides by it and clamps to [0,1] only for positive durations. Duration <= 0 therefore means no timed expiry/progress.

CursedEnergyDisabledTime.simple: Seconds of cursed-energy lockout applied after the domain sequence.
CursedEnergyDisabledTime.technical: float seconds written directly to StatusController.CursedEnergyDisabledTimeLeft at domain-sequence end, at knockout-finish end, and when a previous domain caster is replaced by a new one. The row value is copied, not added to an existing timer.

HitTargetType.simple: Which characters are inside the domain.
HitTargetType.technical: EGameHitTargetType. FBattleFreeState_DomainExpansion::GetDomainTargets switches on it to build candidates (for example AllyOnly selects the caster's own team); those targets drive sequence bindings, forced actions and the Characters list used by the domain state. Default None.

bFinishOtherDomainExpansion.simple: Whether this caster's knockout finish also ends the opponent's domain.
bFinishOtherDomainExpansion.technical: bool. In EndKnockOutFinish, when true and a domain target is valid, the code calls EndSequenceTarget() (which removes that target's domain buffs and applies its CursedEnergyDisabledTime) and awards a finish battle-log value; no effect when false.

bTargetCharacterBind.simple: Whether the caster's current target is preferentially bound to the ThirdCharacter sequence tag.
bTargetCharacterBind.technical: bool. When true the domain sequence searches targets for the caster's GetTargetActor() first, then any rival, then the first remaining target, binding the chosen one to GSM_TagThirdCharacter and removing it from the remaining target list. When false it simply takes the first target.

bTeamMemberUniqueBind.simple: Whether same-team targets get dedicated TeamMember sequence tags.
bTeamMemberUniqueBind.technical: bool. When true, remaining targets on the caster's team are bound to GSM_TagTeamMemberFirstCharacter / GSM_TagTeamMemberSecondCharacter; otherwise all remaining targets use GSM_TagSecondCharacter / GSM_TagFourthCharacter. Checked per target after ThirdCharacter binding.

bAdjustGroundLocation.simple: Whether ground placement should adjust character locations when finishing/resuming the domain.
bAdjustGroundLocation.technical: bool passed as the third argument to GameBattle_PlaceCharacters(Caster, Parent->CharacterLocations, bFinished || HasDomainMap, bAdjustGroundLocation). It affects only that placement path; the domain-map branch handles positions from the area's character start transforms.

Id_BuffDebuff_User.simple: BuffDebuff row applied to the domain caster.
Id_BuffDebuff_User.technical: FName resolved with Status_FindBuffDebuffRow(Tables->BuffDebuffDataTables, Id, true). At BeginSequenceTarget the resulting row is passed to ApplyBuffDebuffRow on the caster; RemoveDomainBuffDebuffs resolves the same row and removes states of its BuffDebuff type. None is skipped by the finder.

Id_BuffDebuff_Enemy.simple: BuffDebuff row applied to every rival and removed on domain end.
Id_BuffDebuff_Enemy.technical: FName resolved like Id_BuffDebuff_User. At domain begin the row is applied to all characters on the caster's rival team with the caster as Source; at end the same row's BuffDebuff type is removed from those rivals. GameCharacter also consults this ID in its domain handling. The begin path does not null-check the resolved enemy row before applying it.

SetActionType_Enemy.simple: Action forced on lockable domain targets on opposing teams.
SetActionType_Enemy.technical: EGameCharacterActionType selected in BattleState07_ApplyDomainTargetActions when the target team differs from the caster's. If the value is not None (enum 0), Target->ChangeAction(Type, FGameCharacterActionRequest(true)) is called. Default None.

SetActionType_Ally.simple: Action forced on lockable domain targets on the caster's team.
SetActionType_Ally.technical: EGameCharacterActionType selected when the target's team equals the caster's; same ChangeAction behavior as SetActionType_Enemy when non-None. Default None.

Id_DomainExpansionRate.simple: Reference to the caster's DomainExpansionRate row.
Id_DomainExpansionRate.technical: FName; no direct reader of this property was found in Source/ or Plugins/. DomainExpansionRateDataTable is loaded into DTM +0x7E0, but no resolver connects these IDs to it, so the effect is unverified. Exported rows set all three rate IDs to None, but that is data, not a constraint.

Id_DomainExpansionRate_Ally.simple: Reference to the ally-side DomainExpansionRate row.
Id_DomainExpansionRate_Ally.technical: FName; no direct reader identified. The similarly named `_Ally` exported rows exist in DomainExpansionRateDataTable, but no source code joins this ID to that table. Treat the runtime meaning as unverified.

Id_DomainExpansionRate_Enemy.simple: Reference to the enemy-side DomainExpansionRate row.
Id_DomainExpansionRate_Enemy.technical: FName; no direct reader identified. DomainExpansionRateDataTable has an exported `CP_140_ENEMY` row, but no source code joins this ID to it. Treat the runtime meaning as unverified.

notes: AGameDataTableManager::Tick resolves only DomainExpansionDataTable into DomainExpansionDataTables (Source/Abrams/Private/GameDataTableManager.cpp:255, Source/Abrams/Public/GameDataTableManager.h:166).

Most consumers use the cached AGameCharacter::DomainExpansionRow pointer (+0x418), so changing the table row while a domain is active would not affect the active state; the BuffDebuff rows are resolved separately at begin/end.
Cross-table joins: Id_Map -> MapDataTable, Id_BuffDebuff_User/_Enemy -> BuffDebuffDataTable, Id_DomainExpansionRate* -> DomainExpansionRateDataTable (last join has no identified consumer).
The three rate-reference fields are the only fields here without direct consumers; they are marked observed rather than verified. No localization variants or numbered shards were identified.
Evidence is reconstructed retail-behaviour C++ plus serialized export schema; partial Content prevents ruling out Blueprint/uncooked consumers.

usages.detail: Resolves CharacterSpecialAttack.Id_DomainExpansion into the cached DomainExpansionRow pointer.
Casting and duration timers/ratios derive from CastingTime and Duration, with equipment casting-time bonuses.
Domain sequence state selects targets by HitTargetType, requests the Id_Map stage and applies sequence bindings/actions.
Domain begin/end applies and removes caster/enemy BuffDebuff rows and sets cursed-energy lockout.
Checks bFinishOtherDomainExpansion when a knockout finish targets another domain caster.
